name: PA-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Polymarket prices Democratic win near certain
Open seat after Dwight Evans's retirement
model.rationale: This Philadelphia district carries a +40 Democratic lean, and the only opposition is an independent who has raised about $11,000 with no outside support, while Chris Rabb has raised over $1.4 million. Markets price a Democratic win at roughly 98%, so the seat stays safely Democratic despite the open seat.
model.watch: A surprise strong showing or outside spending for the independent challenger would be the only realistic path to tightening this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Dwight Evans (D) is not on the ballot.
Dennis Mahoney is an independent standing in for the Republican side.

overview:
Dwight Evans's retirement leaves this heavily Democratic Philadelphia seat open, but the fundamentals remain overwhelmingly favorable to the party holding it. The district's partisan lean is roughly +40 Democratic, and no Republican is even on the ballot; the opposition is an independent, Dennis Mahoney, who has raised about $11,000 and has no outside spending behind him.

Democratic nominee Chris Rabb has raised about $1.4 million and benefits from roughly $1.6 million in outside support, dwarfing his opponent's resources. Prediction markets put a Democratic win near 98 percent. With no polls and no expert ratings available, the forecast rests on the district's lean and the lopsided money picture, both pointing to a safe Democratic hold.
